answer: Agents bond stake to a Semaphore identity and commit to an epoch polynomial used in RLN proofs. Each permitted message carries a rate-limit nullifier; duplicate publication under it yields distinct Shamir shares, enabling recovery of the RLN identity secret—not the wallet key. A verifier validates the pair and immediately slashes collateral. Thus Sybil identities incur real cost, whether cultivated in an orchard, on dune, or across tundra.
